Remark
[curvature and Ricci tensor via the $L_X$ operators]

Source: petersen:page-0407 ↗ thm:pet-ch10-curvature-bracket-formula 1. ch10:10.5.26Let $M$ be a symmetric space and $X,Y,Z\in t_p$. Show $R(X,Y)Z=[L_X,L_Y]Z$ and $\operatorname {Ric}(X,Y)=-\operatorname {tr}([L_X,L_Y])$, where $L_X:=\operatorname {ad}_X$.
